descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: swapped deep-link ids.

Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S11 Deep links: own chart survives a re-open in each context; the other context's id never renders or crashes

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 No data or template leakage between Hospital and Nursing Home. This covers lists, charts, the template picker, custom templates, account-wide screens (search, dashboard counts, Task Export, Inbox, mu … (UAT TC-21; TFA-92599 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fixture patients, chart URLs learned by opening each chart once

When Open /snf/<residentId> directly twice (stands in for a reload); open /snf/<hospitalPatientId> and /rounding/<residentId>; open /rounding/<hospitalPatientId> directly twice

Then Own-context deep links show the chart (no sign-in gate, no blank page). Swapped ids never render the other context's record inside the wrong UI and land on a list or a clear not-found, never an error screen.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: own chart mustContain the patient and its context label (chart-only text proves no sign-in gate); swapped routes mustNotContain the swapped patient and 'Something went wrong'. The 2026-10-10 run found the swapped routes crash to 'Something went wrong on this screen' (snf:get ArgumentValidationError), in both directions. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
